description: Codex round 13 P1: path-to-regexp v3.3.0's default `i` flag folds Latin-1 letters with diacritics (Ä↔ä, É↔é, Ö↔ö, Ü↔ü) — verified empirically via `/Ä/i.test('ä') === true` in JS. Round 12's `eq_ignore_ascii_case` Literal handled ASCII only, missing the Latin-1 folds. Round 13 switched to Unicode-aware `to_lowercase`. Pattern matchers were already Unicode-aware via Rust's `regex::RegexBuilder::case_insensitive(true)`. The residual divergence on Unicode special folds (Kelvin sign U+212A, ﬃ ligature, etc.) is documented as a known divergence in D-012; URLs almost never contain special-fold codepoints.
